workflow.name: coveragelinebreakdown
workflow.description: Returns the latest Codecov covered, partial, and uncovered line totals for the selected repositories, optionally filtered by flag.

tests.name: Nested GitLab repository returns aggregate line counts
Codecov flag returns flag-specific line counts
Unknown repository returns a no-data response
tests.assert_script: if (!output || output.error !== 'No line coverage data found') throw new Error('expected no-data response');

queries.label: line_counts
queries.sql_text:
WITH aggregate_rows AS (
  SELECT
    cc.repo_id,
    cc.hits,
    cc.misses,
    cc.partials,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY cc.repo_id
      ORDER BY cc.commit_timestamp DESC, cc.commit_sha DESC
    ) AS row_num
  FROM _tool_codecov_commit_coverages cc
  INNER JOIN _tool_codecov_commits cm
    ON cc.repo_id = cm.repo_id AND cc.commit_sha = cm.commit_sha
  WHERE :flag = ''
    AND cc.repo_id IN (:repo_ids)
    AND (COALESCE(cc.hits, 0) + COALESCE(cc.misses, 0) + COALESCE(cc.partials, 0)) > 0
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'red-hat-konflux%'
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'dependabot%'
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'renovate%'
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'snyk-io%'
),
flag_rows AS (
  SELECT
    cov.repo_id,
    cov.hits,
    cov.misses,
    cov.partials,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY cov.repo_id
      ORDER BY cov.commit_timestamp DESC, cov.commit_sha DESC
    ) AS row_num
  FROM _tool_codecov_coverages cov
  INNER JOIN _tool_codecov_commits cm
    ON cov.repo_id = cm.repo_id AND cov.commit_sha = cm.commit_sha
  WHERE :flag <> ''
    AND cov.repo_id IN (:repo_ids)
    AND cov.flag_name = :flag
    AND (COALESCE(cov.hits, 0) + COALESCE(cov.misses, 0) + COALESCE(cov.partials, 0)) > 0
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'red-hat-konflux%'
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'dependabot%'
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'renovate%'
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'snyk-io%'
)
SELECT repo_id, hits, misses, partials
FROM aggregate_rows
WHERE row_num = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT repo_id, hits, misses, partials
FROM flag_rows
WHERE row_num = 1
ORDER BY repo_id

json_schemas.description: Successful Code Coverage line breakdown response.
